summary_en: Nakabayashi will acquire up to 1 million shares (3.68% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 600 million yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 9, 2026 to March 31, 2027, including ToSTNeT-3 purchases, to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 6, 2026, Nakabayashi's board of directors resolved to acquire up to 1 million shares of its own common stock (representing 3.68% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum aggregate consideration of 600 million yen. The acquisition will be conducted through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, including off-exchange purchases via ToSTNeT-3, from November 9, 2026 through March 31, 2027.

The company stated that this share repurchase program is undertaken as part of its capital allocation strategy to strengthen shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency. The company noted that market conditions may result in the acquisition not being fully or partially executed. As of October 31, 2026, the company held 1,653,680 treasury shares against 27,140,614 issued shares excluding treasury stock.
